name: Elf to Kemomimi ~Yareba Yaru Hodo Tsuyoku Naru!~
original_name: エルフとケモミミ ～ヤればヤるほど強くなる！～
source:
"Takemoto," who thinks that the real world is boring, gets reincarnated into a different world that he had longed for.

But when he was about to be killed by a goblin, he got rescued by an elf knight Lelesia and a young cat girl warrior Yoto. They are adventurers seeking a dungeon which houses a treasure that can grant any wish.

Takemoto decides to go with them. Since he cannot fight, he carries their luggage instead. At first, they do not care about him. But he gradually gains their trust and is recognized as a friend.

One day, in order to help Lelesia and Yoto who get caught in a lewd trap in a dungeon, he has sex with them. At that time, for some reason, the girls become stronger. Takemoto learns that he has the power to make the girls stronger if he has sex with them.

Thus, to become stronger, they have sex repeatedly while aiming for the treasure at the bottom of the dungeon. Meanwhile, their feelings begin to grow, as they seek each other out more and more.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1251093]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
认为现实世界很无聊的“竹本”转生到了他向往的异世界。

但当他即将被哥布林杀死时，却被精灵骑士莱莱西亚和年轻的猫女战士尤托所救。他们是冒险家，正在寻找一个地下城，里面藏着可以实现任何愿望的宝藏。

竹本决定和他们一起去。由于他无法战斗，他就帮他们搬运行李。起初，他们并不关心他。但他逐渐赢得了他们的信任并被视为朋友。

有一天，为了帮助陷入地牢淫荡陷阱的莱莱西亚和尤托，他与她们发生了性关系。那时，不知为何，少女们变得更强了。武本得知，如果他与女孩们发生性关系，他就有能力让她们变得更强大。

因此，为了变得更强，他们一边不断地做爱，一边瞄准地牢底部的宝藏。与此同时，随着他们越来越频繁地寻找对方，他们的感情开始升温。

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1251093]Getchu[/url]]
